en-GB.title: Mani Me Driver
en-GB.subtitle: Pickup & Delivery App
en-GB.description:
Mani Me Driver is the official app for Mani Me delivery partners. Handle parcel pickups in the UK and deliveries in Ghana efficiently with our easy-to-use driver app.

FOR UK DRIVERS - PICKUPS:

🚗 Manage Pickups
• View assigned pickup jobs with full details
• Get optimized routes to customer locations
• Navigate with one-tap Google Maps integration

📱 Scan & Verify
• Scan parcel QR codes for quick verification
• Record parcel details and weights
• Handle cash collection with digital tracking

📦 Warehouse Operations
• Return collected parcels to warehouse
• Print shipping labels on the go
• Track your daily collections

FOR GHANA DRIVERS - DELIVERIES:

🚚 Manage Deliveries
• View assigned delivery routes
• Get directions to recipient addresses
• Update delivery status in real-time

📸 Proof of Delivery
• Capture photo proof of delivered parcels
• Record recipient signatures
• Handle failed delivery attempts

📊 Track Performance
• View your earning summary
• Track completed jobs
• Monitor your delivery rating

OTHER FEATURES:

💬 Support Chat
• Direct communication with dispatch
• Report issues instantly
• Get help when needed

🔔 Push Notifications
• Get notified of new job assignments
• Receive schedule updates
• Stay informed in real-time

Join the Mani Me driver network and help connect families between the UK and Ghana. Download now!
en-GB.promotionalText: The official driver app for Mani Me UK-Ghana parcel delivery service.
